pageId.description: Page ID whose session should receive the cookies.

domain.description: Cookie domain; omit to use the current page domain.

path.description: Cookie path; omit for the default path.

httpOnly.description: Mark the cookie as HttpOnly when true.

secure.description: Mark the cookie as Secure when true.

cookies.description: Cookies to set for the page session.

purpose.description: Describe why you are setting cookies, e.g., maintaining login state
